_evidence: Overlay for 0x00441606 on top of counter_0040f0dd+tabs_004413b7 (same 22x44 tables, same row/column indexing). ebp = dword 0x66ec60[row*44+col] sar 8 (0x441648) multiplies a table byte (mul ebp) and the product is divided by edi = 0xf0 (0x441666/0x441691/0x4416bc/0x4416e7): a negative dword gives ebp >= 0xff800000, so a byte >= 0xf1 makes edx >= 0xf0 and the original's div faults. The table's writers keep it an unsigned accumulator clamped at 0x7fffffff (0x4350da 'add; jae' -> 0x7fffffff) or a scaled maximum (0x4415be), so the domain is 0..0x7fffffff (values include 0, small, mid and the 0x7fffffff clamp; 255*0x7fffff/0xf0*0x18 >> 14 > 0xd70, so both sides of every 'cmp eax,0xd70; jle' clamp occur). 0x601d54 is never written (only read by the four imul at 0x441668..0x4416e9): image value 0x18 most of the time, plus a few other patterns (imul cannot fault).
